name: Mermaid Diagrams
description: Renders Mermaid .mmd / .mermaid source to SVG via a local `mmdc` (mermaid-cli) subprocess. Separately installable — requires a headless browser via `@mermaid-js/mermaid-cli` + puppeteer (run `node setup.mjs`). Falls back to the code block when unavailable.
author: Glassbox

requirements.label: npm (Node package manager)
requirements.hint: Mermaid renders in a headless browser and needs `npm` to provision its renderer (@mermaid-js/mermaid-cli + puppeteer). Install Node.js (which includes npm) from nodejs.org, then click Install again — or run the CLI setup below.

provision.note: Installs @mermaid-js/mermaid-cli + puppeteer and downloads a headless Chromium (~hundreds of MB) on first install.
